scenes.title: Why clients vanish after session one
scenes.say: Why do clients vanish right after the first session?

scenes.title: 3 quiet reasons
scenes.say: Usually it is one of three quiet things. They leave without a clear next step. You hand them too much homework. Or the price comes as a surprise afterwards.

scenes.title: Small fix, big change
scenes.say: Replace the vague goodbye with a booked date. Replace the invoice later with one small action they can finish today.

scenes.title: Book the next step before they leave
scenes.say: Book the next step before they even leave the call.
